**1.005: no more half-words where a long dictation is split.**

- **Whole words at the joins:** in longer dictations, Hebrish decodes the take in pieces cut at your pauses. The first word after a pause sometimes lost its start ("ividual" for "individual", "chnically" for "technically"). It now comes out whole. Found by reviewing real phone dictations.
- Not yet tested on a phone. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
